sources.note: Replaces the monotonic zoom-in that tool-using video agents follow once they pick a region with a policy that self-checks each tool observation and can switch regions, and trains it with turn-level credit applied multiplicatively -- reweighting the trajectory advantage's magnitude while preserving its sign -- rather than additively.
sources.title: SCOUT: Self-Checking and Recovery-Aware Tool-Thought Agents for Ultra-Long Egocentric Video Reasoning

sources.note: Trains a multimodal agent to orchestrate twelve video-analysis tools for anomaly detection with GRPO under a dual reward that combines exact-match rule checks with an LLM judge scoring logicality, relevance and completeness, and releases the benchmark it is evaluated on.
sources.title: VTO: Visual Tool Orchestration for Video Anomaly Detection

sources.note: Profiles the dominant failure mode of an agent task family on development data, then freezes a policy that permits only the recovery interventions matched to that failure -- so a failure decides which repair is admissible and how much evidence to spend, rather than triggering more context indiscriminately.
sources.title: Diagnosis Before Recovery: Turning Agent Failures into Selective Self-Correction

result.definition: Sequencing several tools whose outputs feed each other, as distinct from selecting one tool for one query, and across 3 sources a separate capability rather than more of the same. The benchmark evidence: separating single-tool from interrelated-tool responses shows one baseline at 0 percent whole-response accuracy on the interrelated split, another at 4.52, and a model roughly nine times larger than the trained system reaching only 67.40 -- while all perform acceptably on isolated tools. The sequencing failure over time is complementary: prior systems follow a monotonic zoom-in and cannot revise, and results on a 41-minute benchmark do not predict results on multi-hour ones, with one agent leading the first and losing 35 points on the second. And the recovery side is measured too, with a diagnosis-first harness whose ablation shows action restriction and matched instruction worth 49 points together and under 4 apart. A benchmark not separating the two capabilities will report a system as competent that cannot chain.
